info.name: EdgeVerify API
info.description:
EdgeVerify — AML / sanctions screening, transaction monitoring & KYC risk engine.

Built by Secure Edge Technologies Limited (SETS).

## Setup
1. Set the `baseUrl` variable (e.g. https://api.edgeverify.io or http://localhost:3000)
2. Log in via the **Auth / Log in** request and copy the returned token into the `token` variable
3. All subsequent requests will authenticate automatically
